productName: AIA One Absolute – Cancer & Serious Infectious Disease Protection

trends.whatProductOffers: Pays a lump sum for cancer and carcinoma-in-situ based on an objective severity score of the medical journey rather than a fixed diagnosis-based payout, with benefits of up to 160% of the Sum Assured.

keyFigures.label: Payment basis
keyFigures.value: Severity score from a transparent scoring table
keyFigures.condition: the table can be checked by the client

exclusionsOrConditions: The payout depends on the severity score, not on the diagnosis alone.
The benefit ceiling is 160% of the Sum Assured.
Waiting periods and underwriting rules are not in the extracted text.
Cover is for cancer and carcinoma-in-situ only under this trend; other conditions are addressed separately.
clientSignalPhrases: wants cancer cover that pays by severity
asked how the score is calculated
had a cancer scare in the family
wants a lump sum not a reimbursement
comparing against a traditional CI plan
wants cover that lasts to retirement
negativeSignalPhrases: wants a guaranteed fixed sum on diagnosis
only buys on the lowest premium
clientProfileFit: Existing CI holders wanting a second layer
trends.talkingPointTemplate: For {client_detail}, the payout scales with how serious the cancer journey is, up to 160% of the sum assured, instead of one fixed diagnosis payout.
verificationPrompts: Confirm the severity scoring table and point thresholds in the policy contract.
Confirm the waiting period and any survival period.
Confirm how carcinoma-in-situ scores under the table.
Confirm the specified Sum Assured needed for the 20% premium discount.
sourceEvidence: AIA has created an innovative, first-in-market cancer protection that determines your claims based on severity.
provides payments of up to 160% of your Sum Assured based on an objective assessment of the severity of the insured's medical journey for cancer and carcinoma-in-situ
We calculate claims using our transparent scoring table, which you can check for yourself, giving you a greater sense of certainty about your claim.
trends.notesForReviewer: Brochure extract stops after the Cover at a glance table, so the benefit schedule, waiting period and full exclusions were not visible.

trends.whatProductOffers: Extends the lump-sum benefit to serious infectious diseases such as COVID-19 while it remains a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, and to possible future global outbreaks, alongside the cancer cover.

keyFigures.label: COVID-19
keyFigures.condition: while COVID-19 is still a PHEIC according to the WHO

keyFigures.label: Future outbreaks
keyFigures.value: Cover for possible future global outbreaks

exclusionsOrConditions: COVID-19 cover applies only while COVID-19 is still a PHEIC according to the WHO.
The list of covered infectious diseases and their definitions is not in the extracted text.
Infectious disease claims are judged against the policy contract, not the marketing examples.

negativeSignalPhrases: budget only stretches to a basic hospital plan

trends.talkingPointTemplate: For {client_detail}, the plan also pays for serious infectious diseases such as COVID-19 and possible future outbreaks, not just cancer.
verificationPrompts: Confirm which infectious diseases remain covered once the PHEIC status ends.

sourceEvidence: We have also added cover for serious infectious diseases, like COVID-19 and even possible future global outbreaks.
Applicable while COVID-19 is still a PHEIC according to the World Health Organization (WHO).
trends.notesForReviewer: Only the COVID-19/PHEIC example is quantified in the extract; the full infectious disease list is missing.

trends.whatProductOffers: Offers a permanent 20% premium discount above a specified Sum Assured, plus an instant 10% premium discount for the first year for AIA Vitality members.

keyFigures.label: Permanent discount
keyFigures.condition: above a specified Sum Assured, standard premiums only

exclusionsOrConditions: The 20% discount applies to standard premiums only and only above a specified Sum Assured.
The 10% discount applies to the first policy year only.
The Sum Assured threshold for the 20% discount is not stated in the extracted text.

productLevelSummary.bestForOneLiner: A severity-scored lump-sum plan for cancer and serious infectious disease that pays up to 160% of the sum assured.
notSuitedWhen: The client wants hospital bills reimbursed rather than a lump sum.
The client wants a fixed payout on a named diagnosis.
The client needs VHIS certification or tax deduction.
The client's budget only supports a very small sum assured.
